topics.name: nanoCMS Navigation Metadata
topics.purpose: Define labels, breadcrumb participation, menu grouping and presentation ordering as non-semantic navigation metadata.

semantics.page_rule: Navigation metadata binds exact page identities.
semantics.order_rule: Menu order is presentation metadata only.
semantics.breadcrumb_rule: Breadcrumbs derive from explicit page containment/navigation refs.
semantics.visibility_rule: Navigation-hidden does not imply inaccessible and navigation-visible does not imply authorized.
semantics.group_rule: Menu grouping creates no semantic resource hierarchy.
semantics.authority_rule: Navigation metadata has no operation authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

prose.summary: Define labels, breadcrumb participation, menu grouping and presentation ordering as non-semantic navigation metadata.
